Answer: C
Reason: The provided axial CT image demonstrates a soft tissue mass in the left paratracheal region (left hilum/mediastinum) that is compressing and deviating the trachea. This location corresponds to the path of the left recurrent laryngeal nerve, and invasion or compression by a tumor here is a classic cause of dysphonia (hoarseness), correlating with the finding of left hilar enlargement on a chest X-ray.
